answer: Sybil tax: each new identity pays a 90-unit non-refundable levy before earning. It is sunk: an honest agent pays once, earns 15 back per clean epoch, recovering it in 6. A forger pays more: a nebula of 1,000 clones prepays 90,000, and each clone caught forfeits the rest and freezes 8 epochs. The thread of receipts is public: one payment cannot serve many faces. Honest history grows like a juniper, one ring per epoch; fakes pay per clone.
